# City of Raleigh Official Website

> > Official website for the City of Raleigh, North Carolina, providing municipal services, parks and recreation programs, urban planning initiatives, and civic engagement opportunities.

Raleighnc.gov serves as the primary digital gateway for residents and visitors to access city services, pay bills, engage with community programs, and stay informed about transportation, sustainability, and cultural resources. The site features information on Raleigh's parks system including Lake Lynn West Loop Trail, Marsh Creek Greenway, and historic sites like Latta University Historic Park, along with civic initiatives managed by the Arts Commission and Public Art and Design Board.

## Key Topics

- Parks and Recreation
- City Services and Payments
- Public Transportation and BikeRaleigh
- Sustainability and Climate Action
- Community Programs and Youth Activities
- Urban Planning and Area Plans
- Public Art and Cultural Resources
- Civic Engagement and Volunteering
- Historic Parks and Preservation
- Raleigh Municipal Building
- Moore Square
- Arts Commission
- Planning Academy
- Greenways and Trails

## City Services and Payments

- [Make Payments](https://raleighnc.gov/make-payments): Pay utilities, parking, permits, licenses, and water bills online

## Parks, Recreation and Community Programs

- [Parks, Recreation and Cultural Resources](https://raleighnc.gov/departments/parks-recreation-and-cultural-resources): Parks, greenways, arts programs, and community events department
- [Summer Camp](https://raleighnc.gov/summer-camps): Youth summer camp programs and family activities in Raleigh parks

## Transportation and Sustainability

- [Transportation](https://raleighnc.gov/transportation-department): Public transit, BikeRaleigh, parking, and Raleigh Transit Authority info
- [Sustainability](https://raleighnc.gov/sustainability): Climate action, environmental programs, and Raleigh Rainwater Rewards

## Civic Engagement

- [Engage With the City](https://raleighnc.gov/engage-city): Civic engagement, volunteer opportunities, and community participation

## Planning and Development Projects

- [Latta University Historic Park Master Plan](https://raleighnc.gov/projects/latta-university-historic-park-master-plan): Master plan for Latta University Historic Park development project
- [Midtown-St. Albans Area Plan](https://raleighnc.gov/midtown-st-albans): Urban planning area plan for Midtown-St. Albans district

## Media and Communications

- [Media Kit](https://raleighnc.gov/media-kit): Media resources for Raleigh city events and news highlights
